title: Silicone Flat Gasket/Water Tank Joint Silicone Gasket/Threaded Waterproof Sealing Gasket Complete Specifications
description:
Silicone Flat Gasket/Water Tank Joint Silicone Gasket/Threaded Waterproof Sealing Gasket Complete Specifications
Precautions For Trading

** Since This Store Is An Overseas Store, The Purchase Amount Is Less Than Nt $60, It Is Not Pre-Shipped, Please Understand

** We Are An Overseas Direct-Selling Store. The Arrival Time Of The Goods Is Generally 5-8 Days After The Order Is Placed. Those Who Place An Order And Cancel And Do Not Pick Up The Goods Will Be Held Personally Responsible!!!

** Urgent, If You Want To Go Abroad, Be Careful When You Are In A Hurry, Do Not Accept Urgent Orders

Product Name: Aquarium Special Widened Silicone Flat Washer.

Material: Food Grade High Quality Environmentally Friendly Silicone (ROHS)

Product Specifications: Inner Diameter * Outer Diameter * Thickness (Special Specifications Are Customized)

Uses: Suitable For Sealing The Threaded Butt Joints Of The Water Tank Opening.And And The Threaded Peripheral Seal.

Note: Due To The Thread Standard, The Left And Left Two In The Picture Below Are Only Suitable For The Use Of Male Threads Of Sets Of 6.7cm And 5cm, Not Suitable For Tubes Of Sets Of 6.7cm And 5cm.There Is No Limit For Other Specifications Because Of The Minimal Difference.
